hook: Drum blast at Uppal food unit kills a *35-year-old* worker
hook_b: Drum blast at Uppal food unit kills a *35-year-old* worker
tldr: A woman disposing of waste at the Heritage Foods unit in IDA Uppal died when a drum exploded around 3 pm on Saturday, per Telangana Today.

beats.what: Uppal police booked a case and are investigating the cause; her body was taken to Gandhi Hospital for postmortem.
beats.why: The blast happened during routine waste disposal on the company premises.
beats.care: Workers staged a protest outside the unit demanding justice and compensation; she is survived by three children.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today reports the incident raised safety concerns among workers at the industrial unit.

cards.q: What should come first after a factory death like this?

qs: Who inspects safety at units inside Hyderabad's industrial development areas?

facts.t: The worker, from Gandhi Nagar in Ramanthapur, is survived by *three children*.

viz.verdict: A worker died; the cause is still being probed
